First public release. `count_nonempty()` counts the lines that contain at least one character, including lines made only of spaces.

## Try it with your data

From a checkout with rustup installed:

```sh
cargo run --quiet -p line-count --example count
# 2
```

## Upgrade from 0.0.x

No caller changes are needed. The API is the same as the last 0.0.x prototype.
